findings.oracle: Real input bytes(range(16)) through HexPatInterpreter.execute_bytes; oracle is the identity mapping offset->value of bytes(range(16)); asserts exactly 4 fields with names==['byte']*4, offsets==[0,1,2,3], sizes==[1,1,1,1], raw_bytes==[[0],[1],[2],[3]], display_value==['0x0','0x1','0x2','0x3'].

Real input b'\x01\x02\x03\x00\x05\x06'; oracle is the input layout (three non-zero bytes then 0x00 sentinel); asserts exactly 3 fields at offsets [0,1,2] with raw_bytes [[1],[2],[3]] and display_value ['0x1','0x2','0x3'], and that offsets 3,4,5 were never parsed.

Real input b'\x42...'; false guard run!=0 skips body, post-loop field 'after' proves continuation; asserts exactly 1 field named 'after' at offset 0 reading 0x42 (display '0x42') and that 'inside' never appears. Paired with new test_while_true_condition_executes_body proving the true-guard path places its field, per the audit fix recommendation.

Real input bytes(range(8)) with loop i<5; oracle is identity mapping of bytes(range(8)); asserts exactly 5 fields named ['elem']*5 at offsets [0..4] with raw_bytes [[0]..[4]] and display_value ['0x0'..'0x4'], stopping before offsets 5..7.

Real input bytes([1,2,3,4,5,*([0]*10),0x7E]); oracle is the hand-computed sum 1+2+3+4+5=15 plus a unique 0x7E marker byte planted only at offset 15; asserts exactly 1 field 'marker' at offset 15, size 1, raw_bytes [0x7E], display_value '0x7E' (a wrong accumulation would land on a 0x00 byte).

Real 4-byte input b'\xaa\xbb\xcc\xdd'; oracle is buffer geometry (u32 fits only at offset 0; offsets 1,2,3 run off the end and trigger catch); asserts exactly 4 fields names==['big','small','small','small'], offsets [0,1,2,3], sizes [4,1,1,1], the u32 raw_bytes [0xAA,0xBB,0xCC,0xDD] with little-endian display_value '0xDDCCBBAA', and the recovered u8 bytes/display ['0xBB','0xCC','0xDD'].
